tasks.title: Test compact multi-hypothesis generation with discriminative verification

tasks.progress: Motivated by ARC-R017: exact full training replay passed on 6/8 yet treatment fell from 4/8 to 1/8; next experiment should attack ambiguity and output-token burden rather than repeat the rejected gate.
